name: Sports Odds API (BetRivers, Unibet & 22 more books)
description: Live odds from 24 Kambi-powered sportsbooks in one call — BetRivers (12 US states + Ontario), Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG. One row per game with every book's price and the best price per outcome. Hosted Streamable HTTP via Apify MCP; Apify OAuth.
author: publicrecords
